confidence_definition: Posterior over H_known under a uniform class prior and the stated Gaussian noise model, with fault magnitude marginalised over the EXP-0011 grid. It is a probability CONDITIONAL on the hypothesis space containing the truth -- the condition this experiment deliberately violates. It is NOT the probability that the diagnosis is correct.

UF-001.name: angle-of-attack vane stiction
UF-001.rationale: A vane bearing with static friction only updates once the true angle has moved more than delta. The library's "stuck" fault is a TOTAL freeze; this is a partial, signal-dependent freeze, so no library hypothesis represents it.

UF-002.name: rate-gyro saturation
UF-002.rationale: The gyro's measurement range is exceeded and the output clips. The library's scale fault is linear; this is a nonlinearity active only at high rate.

UF-003.name: pitot line partial blockage (pneumatic lag)
UF-003.rationale: A restricted pitot line raises the pneumatic time constant -- a documented air data failure mode. No dynamic or filtering fault exists in the library.

UF-004.name: static-port blockage (cross-channel)
UF-004.rationale: One blocked static port corrupts barometric altitude and airspeed simultaneously. Every library fault is single-channel, and NO library fault acts on altitude at all, so part of this signature is structurally unexplainable.

UF-005.name: pitch static-stability loss
UF-005.rationale: Partial horizontal-stabiliser damage or an aft CG shift reduces static pitch stiffness. The library's only plant fault (F6) changes CONTROL effectiveness, not STABILITY -- deliberately the hardest plant case, since both have pitch-axis signatures.

UF-006.name: airframe icing drag rise
UF-006.rationale: Ice accretion increases parasite drag. No aerodynamic-degradation hypothesis exists in the library.
